Condition-based approval routing — test cases and run

The workflow builder, the General Details section of the PO form after awarding, the dependent dropdowns, which workflow matches, what Submit does, and the APIs behind them. Every case with an automated check carries the live result and a screenshot. Plain words; every click named as it reads on screen.

Before you test

  1. DLF Hospitality UAT has real people in it. Name every workflow “QA_Platform …”, make yourself its only approver, delete it when done.
  2. Never submit through the company “test” catch-all workflows — they route to all DLF super admins / managers / members.
  3. Use RFX-2112 (vendor Demo10, made by the test user). Reject your own approval afterwards so the event returns to draft.
  4. Do not touch the “hello”, “GD Test …” and “test” workflows.
  5. Record = the rule is not settled: write what happens and raise it to product.

The flow (pass / cases)

Test cases

Rules behind the cases

What routes a PO
Five dropdowns in the PO form's General Details: Form Type (= the event's RFQ template, locked), Unit Name (= the PR line's location, or the user's teams' units), Legal Entity (depends on Unit Name), Department, Nature of Expense. Sanction Note and Comments are text only and never route.
Matching
Only Bid Proposal workflows whose team includes the initiator with the stated role (Member/Manager/Admin) are considered; if any TEAM workflow matches, COMPANY workflows are ignored. Each condition: 'is any of' (OR within the field); all conditions must hold (AND); a field without a condition means any value. Total Proposal Value and the other old conditions combine the same way.
Submit
One match → attached. Several → the buyer picks. None → 2017 and no submit (never reachable on DLF UAT while the three company 'test' catch-alls exist). Mandatory fields empty → 2016 'Please fill …'. Chosen workflow no longer matching → 523 'Invalid Approval' and the modal reloads.
After submit
General Details read-only; the approval request keeps meta_data.data.routing (values, workflow, rule, match_count, user_selected). Rejection → a new draft with the same values.
Where the lists come from
Form Type: trade templates; Unit Name: buyer hubs (34 on UAT, incl. junk ones); Legal Entity, Department, Nature of Expense: widget data mapping rows gd_legal_entity / gd_department / gd_nature_of_expense, nesting through pc:unit_name. The builder's condition values come from approval_conditions filled by a sync script.
Not built (PRD vs PR)
Nested value pickers in the builder; overlap warning; auto-select of a single server-backed child; keep-if-still-valid on parent change (everything is cleared); General Details on the approval page; PO listing filters and export; lock on an auto-filled Unit Name (optional).

Sources: PRD V2, backend PR Procol-Tech/procol-backend#17421, dashboard commit 02e23631e8, DLF UAT data, and the run of 3 Nov 2026 (scripts procol-ui-tests/scripts/aw-*.ts).
